correctness.rationale: For each ideal I the orthomorphism maps I into I, hence permutes I. Therefore each element and its orthomorphism have the same principal ideal. Permutation cycles of the complete mapping force it to preserve J classes. On each rectangular D class, row permutations and independently chosen column-wise permutations give a bijection, the exact image, constant fibers, total factorial count and cycle distribution. Seven enumerated finite bands covering 41,952 permutations corroborated this universal symbolic argument.
